text:
jen_support: FYI customer ACME (tenant: acme-inc-42) opened a P1. SCIM provisioning started failing ~2024-10-09T10:12Z with 503s; their repro shows repeated retries that created a large audit export. They also can't download the audit export for last 48h (returns 500). Logs show a recurring KMS unwrap error: `unwrap failed: HSM_UNWRAP(14)` and `kms client: latency=1200ms`. Billing team flagged a token/ops spike from retry storms. Tagging @priya_security @alec_sre @marco_infra @kate_cse. case=#12345

kate_cse: can you paste minimal repro steps and the exact failing API call? also need tenant id + example user id and exact time window so we can pull traces.

jen_support: repro steps pinned below (from customer):
- SCIM POST /Provision to /v1/tenants/acme-inc-42/scim with batch of 200 users
- many return 503s then client retries every 10s for 5 attempts
- example failing request id: req_0a9f3b
- timeframe: 2024-10-09T10:12:03Z -> 2024-10-09T10:26:00Z

logs (sanitized):
```
2024-10-09T10:12:03Z req=req_0a9f3b SCIM 503 upstream
2024-10-09T10:12:03Z kms: unwrap failed key=k-42 err=HSM_UNWRAP(14) latency=1203ms
2024-10-09T10:12:04Z provisioner: abort batch=acme-200 reason=KMS_UNWRAP
```

alec_sre: re: throttle — our SCIM gateway default burst is 25r/s and sustained 10r/s per-tenant. That said the provisioner should circuit-break on repeated KMS unwraps instead of retrying forever. I'll pull the request traces; can someone confirm whether ACME is on dedicated or hosted? that changes routing.

jen_support: hosted (standard org), not dedicated.

marco_infra: KMS unwrap errors + >1s latency points to HSM vendor slowness or network blips to KMS region. I see a short spike in KMS error rate in metrics around 10:11-10:15Z. kms-bot alert fired: `KMS_UNWRAP_ERROR rate elevated 10:10 -> 10:20`.

kms-bot: [automated] Alert acknowledged by marco_infra. Incident link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2024-10-238

priya_security: thanks. two asks from compliance/legal: (1) export full audit log for tenant acme-inc-42 for 2024-10-08T00:00 -> 2024-10-10T00:00 (they need chain-of-custody evidence). (2) confirm whether any sensitive plaintext was logged or leaked during retries. we also need a signed statement if we rotate/wrap keys for remediation.

kate_cse: customer is asking for a temporary workaround asap — suggested: create a short-lived service account with SCIM Provisioner role and whitelist it to bypass per-tenant throttles for 4h so they can finish backlog. do we have org approval for that? @priya_security

priya_security: short-lived escalation is acceptable with controls: oAuth client should be scoped, narrow role, TTL <= 4h, audit posted to evidence bundle. set explicit approval in the case notes. Also we should avoid key rotation until we confirm HSM root cause because rotation would invalidate wrapped keys in-flight.

jen_support: performed workaround at 2024-10-09T13:02Z: created sa:sa-scim-provision-temp with TTL 4h, granted role `scim.provisioner` scoped to acme-inc-42, whitelisted IPs per customer request. customer confirmed provisioning backlog cleared by 13:30Z. :thumbsup:

alec_sre: thanks. next steps from infra side: (1) add a circuit breaker so that after 3 consecutive KMS unwrap errors for a tenant we stop automatic retries for 10m and return 5xx to client; (2) add a short-term throttling exception guard for vetted service accounts to avoid retry storms; (3) add dashboards for unwrap latency by region. I'll open tickets.

marco_infra: opening infra tasks and vendor escalation to HSM provider now. assigning to ENG-OPS and KMS vendor thread. we'll include HSM vendor trace ids and the raw unwrap logs. timeline: expect vendor ack within 6h.

priya_security: to satisfy compliance evidence: please attach the exported audit bundle to the case and include MD5 checksums, signer (marco_infra), and the chain-of custody doc. mark whether any audit rows were missing; if export API returned 500, snapshot S3 copies and attach.

jen_support: export attempted at 2024-10-09T11:40Z failed with 500. I retried via internal admin export and succeeded at 2024-10-09T12:05Z. uploaded bundle to case storage: s3://evidence/cases/12345/audit-bundle-20241009.tar.gz md5=3b1f8e9c0d7a2f4b6cfa

priya_security: verified the MD5 and signed the chain-of-custody doc. I scanned the bundle — no plaintext keys in logs. HSM unwrap errors only show `HSM_UNWRAP` code, no key material. marking compliance hold cleared for this window but require postmortem.

kate_cse: customer requested a short postmortem they can share with their internal auditors. can we draft a redacted summary including timeline, root cause (vendor HSM latency), mitigations (circuit breaker, temp SA, vendor escal), and next steps (monitoring + vendor patch)?

alec_sre: will own the postmortem draft. Marco please include vendor response and whether a permanent key rewrap is required. Priya please add the compliance section.

marco_infra: vendor initial response: intermittent HSM latency due to scheduled firmware rollout in their cluster; they are rolling back the firmware and monitoring. vendor suggested no key rewrap required; recommending patch for HSM firmware and repeated unwrap backoff. I'll paste vendor email into case thread.

jen_support: customer satisfied for now. closing customer-facing action items. keeping thread open for infra/postmortem. thanks all.

priya_security: noted. leaving a required action: compliance review of RBAC policy for service account issuance (least-privilege checklist). assigning to security-runbook queue.

alec_sre: adding a follow-up issue: SVC-1021 - provisioner circuit-breaker + retry policy + metrics. assigning to eng-runtime.

jen_support: closing out after postmortem and evidence upload. case updated. :white_check_mark:
